turns.text: Hi, um, yes, good morning. I need to change a flight, I think. It's, um, it's the Saturday flight to Mumbai.
Good morning, I can help with that. First I need to verify the booking, so could you give me your booking code and the last name on the reservation?
Um, the code... I'm sorry, I don't have it with me. The last name is Novak, Peter Novak.
Thanks, Mr. Novak. Without the booking code I can't verify the reservation or make any changes. Is the code in your confirmation email?
Hmm. I... I think I deleted that email, sorry. Can I use my phone number instead? And the last four of the card I paid with, that's 4417.

I'm sorry, a phone number and card digits aren't enough for me to verify the booking. I need the booking code together with your last name before I can touch the flight. If you find the code, I can take it from there, or I can arrange a supervisor callback.
Oh. Okay. Um... I really need to move it, my plans changed. Is there any way you can just look it up by my name?
I can't look up a booking by name alone, I'm sorry. A supervisor callback may be able to help with that, or you can find the code and call back.
A supervisor. Um, how long would that take? I'm kind of in a rush.
I don't have a time for the callback, but I can note the request. What's the best number to reach you on?
Sure, it's, um, 050... sorry, 050 555 0142. Also, if I move it, would I have to pay a fee?
Changes are free within 24 hours of booking. After that, Economy carries a $75 fee plus any fare difference, and changes aren't allowed within two hours of departure.
Okay, that's, um, more than I thought. Well, I'll try to find the email. Thanks for your help anyway.
You're welcome. No changes have been made today. If you find the booking code, call back and we can take it from there.
